notes: Fair and solvable. Each decoy fails on exactly one constraint, so you have to check all six against every card. The peanut allergy is the most indirect clue: nobody says 'I'm allergic'. You only get it from Cyrus binning the peanut dressing plus Brooke's 'satay incident' callback, and the chat never says who has the allergy. That callback assumes the player knows earlier levels; a first-time player could still infer it, but it is the clue most likely to be missed. Maya's budget line ('three signs won't sink me... but i will bring it up') clearly marks $$$ as a soft one-tier penalty rather than a deal-breaker, which fits the rules. Starboard is a strong trap, since it is quiet, light and has a veg page, with the peanuts mentioned only late in its second review. Nothing contradictory found.
